description: LunarWing Kimi Code Worker — WebSocket agent communication protocol

task_request.description: Agent → Worker: submit a coding task

payload.context: object — optional TaskContext. conversation_history contains bounded user/assistant messages used only as untrusted JSON reference context; metadata, environment, and user_id are never added to model prompts. cron_tick.event = cron.tick enables creation of a relative project_dir under WORKSPACE_ROOT; creation is descriptor-relative and never creates through a symlink component (the returned path is re-resolved and confined to the root); ordinary tasks do not create directories
payload.timeout_ms: integer — hard deadline for the task (default 14400000)

cancel.description: Agent → Worker: cancel an in-flight task

tool_result.description: Agent → Worker: WI#324 reply to a tool_call. Routed by the bridge relay to the in-task MCP shim by call_id.

payload.error: string | null — sanitized reason for error/denied

tool_catalog.description: Agent → Worker: WI#324 reply to tool_list. Contains exactly the tools this worker may call (allowlist + phase-1 gates applied).

payload.tools: array of { name, description, parameters (JSON schema) }
payload.error: string — present instead of tools on failure (fail-closed)

tool_call.description: Worker → Agent: WI#324 proxied tool invocation. task_id must equal the job this connection serves; frames over 256 KiB are rejected with error.

payload.task_id: string — the active job id (required, binding)
payload.name: string — allowlisted tool name

tool_list.description: Worker → Agent: WI#324 request for the callable tool catalog. Payload {} (task_id optional, must equal the job id when present). Shares the per-job 100 control-frame budget with tool_call.

task_result.description: Worker → Agent: final result after completion

payload.error: string | null — error message if status=error

ready.description: Worker → Agent: sent once on connect to signal readiness

error_codes.4001: Unauthorized — invalid or missing auth token
error_codes.4002: Task not found — cancel referencing unknown task_id
error_codes.4004: Rate limited — too many concurrent tasks
